SgtHammerAmbush.name: Ambush
SgtHammerAmbush.description: Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

SgtHammerSiegeModeAdvancedArtillery.name: Advanced Artillery
SgtHammerSiegeModeAdvancedArtillery.description: Increase Siege Mode's splash damage to 60% of Basic Attack damage, and increase its splash radius by 25%.

SgtHammerSiegeModeMaelstromRounds.name: Maelstrom Rounds
SgtHammerSiegeModeMaelstromRounds.description: Activate to increase Basic Attack damage dealt by 40% for 5 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode reduces the cooldown of Maelstrom Rounds by 5 seconds. Stores up to 3 charges.

SgtHammerBarricade.name: Barricade
SgtHammerBarricade.description: Reduce Concussive Blast's cooldown by 4 seconds, its Mana cost by 40, and when cast create an impassable wall in front of Sgt. Hammer for 4 seconds.

SgtHammerNeosteelPlatingSiegeTactics.name: Siege Tactics
SgtHammerNeosteelPlatingSiegeTactics.description: Using Neosteel Plating while in Siege Mode grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds, as long as she remains in Siege Mode.

SgtHammerSiegeModeRegenerativeBioSteel.name: Regenerative Bio-Steel
SgtHammerSiegeModeRegenerativeBioSteel.description: Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

SgtHammerSpiderMinesPulseDetonationCore.name: Pulse Detonation Core
SgtHammerSpiderMinesPulseDetonationCore.description: Spider Mines detonate 3 times over 3 seconds. All damage from Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Spider Mines by 1.5 seconds. Increase this bonus to 2.5 seconds while in Siege Mode.

SgtHammerMasteryHoverSiegeMode.name: Hover Siege Mode
SgtHammerMasteryHoverSiegeMode.description: Sgt. Hammer can move at 50% Movement Speed while in Siege Mode.

SgtHammerGraduatingRange.name: Graduating Range
SgtHammerGraduatingRange.description: While in Siege Mode, Basic Attack range is increased by 1 every 1.5 seconds, up to 3.

SgtHammerHeroicAbilityBluntForceGun.name: Blunt Force Gun
SgtHammerHeroicAbilityBluntForceGun.description: Fire a missile across the battlefield, dealing 500 damage to enemies in its path. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

SgtHammerHeroicAbilityNapalmStrike.name: Napalm Strike
SgtHammerHeroicAbilityNapalmStrike.description: Deals 164 damage on impact, and leaves a napalm area that deals 50 damage per second. Lasts for 4 seconds.

SgtHammerSpiderMinesTacticalMineDeployme.name: Tactical Mine Deployment
SgtHammerSpiderMinesTacticalMineDeployme.description: Moving while Thrusters is active leaves a trail of up to 5 Spider Mines. Additionally, increase the Slow of Spider Mines by 15%.

SgtHammerConcussiveBlastEntrenched.name: Entrenched
SgtHammerConcussiveBlastEntrenched.description: While in Siege Mode, Concussive Blasts's damage and knockback distance are increased by 75%.

SgtHammerHyperCoolingEngines.name: Hyper-Cooling Engines
SgtHammerHyperCoolingEngines.description: While in Siege Mode, hitting Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Thrusters by 5 seconds.

SgtHammerNeosteelPlatingMechanicalKnowho.name: Mechanical Know-how
SgtHammerNeosteelPlatingMechanicalKnowho.description: Neosteel Plating grants 20% maximum Health as a Shield for 2 seconds and increases Basic Attack damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

HeroGenericExecutionerPassive.name: Executioner
HeroGenericExecutionerPassive.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

GenericTalentGiantKillerSgtHammer.name: Giant Killer
GenericTalentGiantKillerSgtHammer.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

SgtHammerMasteryOrbitalBFGBluntForceGun.name: Orbital BFG
SgtHammerMasteryOrbitalBFGBluntForceGun.description: Blunt Force Gun's missile orbits the planet every 5 seconds. Only the last missile fired orbits.

SgtHammerMasteryAdvancedLavaStrikeNapalm.name: Advanced Lava Strike
SgtHammerMasteryAdvancedLavaStrikeNapalm.description: Increase the cast range of Napalm Strike by 75%, and its impact deals 65% more damage.

SgtHammerSpiderMinesShrapnelMines.name: Shrapnel Mines
SgtHammerSpiderMinesShrapnelMines.description: Upon detonating, Spider Mines reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 10, up to 50, for 4 seconds.

SgtHammerSiegeModeUltraCapacitors.name: Ultra Capacitors
SgtHammerSiegeModeUltraCapacitors.description: Hitting enemy Heroes or Structures with Basic Attacks while in Siege Mode grants 10% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 60%.
